families.title: Integrate affine exponentials after exact simplification
families.learner_decisions: Recognise the affine exponent, compensate for its inner coefficient and simplify products/quotients before integrating.
families.givens_and_unknowns: Exp(ax+b), sums or exponential quotient; unknown primitive.
families.constraints: Use original real domains, signed bounds and source-given versus worked diagrams. A proper interval cannot cross a pole. General substitution, unscaffolded partial fractions and integration by parts are not prescribed8227methods. Retained extra-method responses are internal boundary evidence; their existence does not certify coverage.
families.representation_and_response: Integrand to primitive.
families.scaffolding_and_connected_parts: No definite endpoint output is invented.
families.alternative_methods: Reverse differentiation, exponent rules and exact linearity.
families.units_and_precision: Preserve the literal angular unit, original interval endpoints, exact-form or decimal instruction and physical dimensions. Intermediate approximations must not change the final rounding or admissibility.
families.answer_form: Primitive plus arbitrary constant on original domain.
families.difficulty_progression: Negative/rational inner coefficients and expanded squares change arithmetic; a constant term is integrated asx.
families.distinction_basis: Exponential recognition differs from a power law or reciprocal logarithm.
